author: Logos III
title: Logos III: Graph PC Sweep (n_pcs=40)
abstract: This experiment begins the dissection of the SOTA's graph construction pipeline. It tests a lower number of principal components (40, vs baseline 50) for the graph's latent space to see if a lower-dimensional representation improves the final score. This uses my optimized SOTA (tau=0.85) as the baseline.
